2. Application - This line output transformer is meant to provide the required scanning amplitude for 470 mm, 510 mm, 590 mm and 610 mm TV picture tubes in television receivers presenting 625 lines at 50 frames per second. It is intended for use in conjuction with: : a) deflection b) linearity unit DCU lS, control unit LCU lS, and stack. is shown in Fig. 1.

Description - The line output transformer shall have primary, secondary, auxiliary and EHT vindings,wound on a ferrite core with suitable resin impregnation/encapsulation. The transformer ;hall meet the self extinguishing and non-dripping requirement of IS : 616-1981 `Safety requirements or mains operated electronic and related apparatus for household and similar general use firsf revision )`.

5. Mounting -The line output transformer shall be with four mounting pins and connecting pins to enable the transformer to be soldered directly into a printed wiring board ( Fig. 3). The following minimum distances between the transformer and neighbouring conductive, surfaces shall be maintained: a) The radial distance between EHT coil and any metal part should be at least 15 mm; and be at least 25 mm. the line output transformer. be at least 25 mm;
